evidence.detail: with_test_db() drops, creates, and sets up the test DB by calling database.setup() which applies all migrations
setup() iterates over decksite/sql/ and applies every patch file in order
76 migration files currently exist, all applied on every test invocation

triage.fix_sketch: Generate `decksite/schema.sql` by dumping the current DB schema (`mysqldump --no-data decksite > decksite/schema.sql`), commit it, and modify decksite/testutil.py's with_test_db() to execute schema.sql directly instead of calling database.setup(). Add a dev.py task (or CI check) to regenerate schema.sql whenever a new file is added to decksite/sql/. The code change is ~10 lines in testutil.py plus the schema.sql file.
triage.notes: Generating schema.sql requires a live database (not available in this environment). The comment notes uncertainty about whether this is actually faster — should time it before committing. Maintenance discipline needed: schema.sql must be updated whenever a new migration file is added.
